hypotheses.title: Gold Super Alpha Expansion: 4 Orthogonal Multi-Factor Engines Targeting GOOD and EXCELLENT Status
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly expands upon the proven mathematical architecture of Approved Alpha 83d5f74b (Sharpe 1.97, Fitness 1.60, Self-correlation 0.5393). Synthesizes institutional options volatility surfaces across four distinct horizons and asset types with orthogonal corporate balance-sheet hedging and customer-supplier supply chain lead-lag networks: (1) 1-Year Put Volatility + FX Hedging: Isolates institutional downside crash protection premia blended with currency translation hedging. (2) 3-Year LEAP Call Volatility + FX Hedging: Captures multi-year institutional strategic positioning with low turnover. (3) 2-Year Put Volatility + FX Hedging: Exploits 2-year structural put demand asymmetry against realized Parkinson volatility. (4) 1-Year Call Volatility + Supply Chain Customer Spillover (pv13): Fuses options flow with customer-to-supplier informational transmission friction.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if institutional options demand reflects hedging panic rather than informed directional conviction.
